title: Collision
description: Collision is Ableton's physical modeling synthesizer, a method where sound is generated by computing a mathematical model rather than traditional oscillators. It's popular for percussive instrumentation, mallet instruments especially. This was a getting-familiar exercise, pushing the synth's parameters and models beyond the mallet sounds it defaults to.

audio.label: Pad
audio.desc: Pad patch. My personal favorite of the bunch, ended up with a nice organ-like quality to it.
